text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, whoa, whoa, whoa!! Look at this 
massive harvest, would ya!?
choice_data_list: I'll give it all to you.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
You're way too generous! Go on a diet! 
Slim down that massive heart of yours!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Heheh...! Then next time it's me! It's 
definitely gonna be me!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna seize ten times more than this 
and present it all to you, Trainer!
